correctness.rationale: Each Petersen edge is a perfect pairing of four of five symbols and falls into one of five three-element fibers. The proof establishes that precisely equal-fiber pairs have line-graph distance three. Thus the radius-two Rips complex is the join of five discrete triples and has free integral fourth homology of rank 32 and no other positive homology. At radius one the ten star-triangles have nerve the Petersen graph, naturally under S5, with first-homology rank six. The Koszul-signed tensor character and the oriented cellular cycle character yield exact class traces (32,0,8,2,0,0,2) and (6,0,-2,0,0,0,1). The local standard-library checker independently enumerates all 105 vertex pairs and face sets at radii one and two, computes exact binary boundary ranks, verifies all 120 group elements by signed fixed-simplex Lefschetz traces, and computes all seven rational character multiplicities. Rational representations are not confused with integral splittings; the join proof independently gives integral torsion-freeness.

originality.rationale: The original contribution is the complete rational S5-equivariant positive-degree persistence: both class characters, the six-dimensional irreducible at radius one, the 32-dimensional irreducible multiplicities at radius two, and the dimension-two invariant subspace. Goyal–Shukla–Singh already cover the radius-one nonequivariant homotopy. DistanceRegular.org already gives the antipodal fibers, diameter three and group S5, so the nonequivariant radius-two sphere count follows by a standard join argument and is not independently claimed new. The full symmetry action on reduced fiber modules and character decomposition require additional signed-tensor and permutation-cycle calculations, and are not stated in the inspected sources or located relevant published research records. value.rationale: The graph is a standard distance-transitive antipodal cover whose line-graph clique topology is well studied. The explicit group-character classification reveals that the six degree-one loops form one irreducible S5 module with no invariants, whereas the 32-dimensional degree-four group has exactly two invariants and six nonzero isotypic components. These structural distinctions are invisible to the already known graph antipodality and nonequivariant Betti ranks. The fiber tensor trace is a motivated reusable tool for equivariant persistent homology of antipodal graph metrics. It is not a cosmetic renaming or an arbitrary graph size cutoff: the symmetry of Petersen and its smallest nontrivial threefold cover are intrinsic.
